description: DSH Measure operator controls: the effective guard mode with a /measure-mode command (session and persisted repository overrides) and a read-only /measure-verify command
deviation_notes: All 13 plan tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded. Deviations: (1) A fresh review found 16 findings (4 Blockers) before the docs were final; all were fixed (the /measure-verify metadata rule for an open track with actual_tasks: null, the git-unavailable reply, the snapshot refresh, the clientView seam API, the consumer list, and the exact texts) or contested with evidence (SessionModes vs Bypass). (2) The live mode test used a repository override written directly to repos.json instead of the /measure-mode slash command, which the agent tool surface cannot invoke; the command itself is covered by unit tests and the live route proved the effective mode. (3) The live reload exposed a defect: toggling trailing newlines did not reliably recompose the profile, so reload/install now toggle a `# measure-dsh reload marker` comment (a real content change); tests and docs were updated. (4) Tasks 1.1-1.4 and 2.1-2.4 landed as one commit each; the review remediation (CLI marker, verify fixes, docs) landed as one more commit. (5) Phase checkpoints use automated verification reports instead of user confirmation because the session runs with approvals disabled.

sprint.goal: The operator can switch the guard mode from the chat (for this session or persisted for a repository), see the effective mode everywhere, and run the git-backed verification on demand.

stories.title: The effective mode and the mode command
